request.acceptance_criteria: The fake tracker's claim counting matches tk's (a re-claim by the same claimant is not a new claim); a test pins the parity; go test ./internal/reconcile/ passes
request.description: Found by #50's author: internal/reconcile/harness_test.go's fake tracker counts a re-claim of an already-claimed tick against the width, which the real tk does not. Tests that depend on width can then pass or fail for a reason production never has. Make the fake match tk's claim semantics and add a test pinning it against tk's own behaviour.
request.title: The reconcile test tracker counts a re-claim as a new claim; real tk does not
